en_title: Razer Reveals New Pokémon Gaming Headsets Featuring Sylveon, Charizard, and Lucario
cn_title: 雷蛇推出三款《宝可梦》主题耳机
subtitle: 三种配色，三只宝可梦
opus_summary: 雷蛇推出三款《宝可梦》主题游戏耳机，分别以仙子伊布、喷火龙和路卡利欧为设计主题，参与系列30周年庆祝活动。新品已在雷蛇及Target开售，后者售价明显更高。

paragraphs.en: Razer just dropped three new Pokémon-inspired headsets.
paragraphs.cn: 雷蛇刚刚推出了三款《宝可梦》主题耳机。

paragraphs.en: The new colorways, which form part of Pokémon’s ongoing 30th anniversary celebrations, are for two of the tech company’s most popular gaming headsets: the Kraken V4 and the Blackshark V3 X Hyperspeed. In typical collab fashion, each design is based on a specific Pokémon. This particular collection puts the spotlight on Sylveon, Charizard, and Lucario.
paragraphs.cn: 这些新配色是《宝可梦》正在举行的30周年庆祝活动的一部分，采用的型号是雷蛇旗下两款最受欢迎的游戏耳机：Kraken V4和Blackshark V3 X Hyperspeed。与常见的联名产品一样，每款设计都以一只特定的宝可梦为主题。这次登场的是仙子伊布、喷火龙和路卡利欧。

paragraphs.en: The headsets are now available directly from Razer and Target, though with a significant markup at the latter.
paragraphs.cn: 这些耳机现已在雷蛇官方渠道和Target开售，不过Target的售价明显更高。

paragraphs.en: The Razer Kraken V4 is getting the Sylveon Edition treatment. This wired headset sports a retractable mic, 7.1 surround sound, and customizable RGB with Razer Chroma. The Sylveon design is all about the pastels, with an image of Sylveon printed on the headband and soft blue details on the earcups. Razer’s own official listing calls the new edition “coquette-style.”
paragraphs.cn: 雷蛇Kraken V4推出了仙子伊布版。这款有线耳机配备可伸缩麦克风，支持7.1环绕声，并可通过Razer Chroma自定义RGB灯效。仙子伊布版以柔和的浅色调为主，头梁上印有仙子伊布图案，耳罩则点缀着淡蓝色细节。雷蛇官方商品页面将新版的设计称为「甜美娇俏风」。

paragraphs.en: The base model headset costs $79.99, and the Sylveon Edition is currently listed at Razer for the same price.
paragraphs.cn: 基础款耳机售价为79.99美元(约合人民币536元)，仙子伊布版目前在雷蛇官网的标价也相同。

paragraphs.en: The Razer Blackshark V3 X Hyperspeed headset is getting two new colorways based on some of the coolest Pokemon, Charizard and Lucario. This is a slightly higher-end headset tuned specifically for esports, with the standard edition priced at $20 more than the Kraken V4. It’s also lighter, weighing 270g to the Kraken’s 300g. Razer boasts a low-latency wireless connection supported by 2.4GHz HyperSpeed technology and up to 70 hours of battery life.
paragraphs.cn: 雷蛇Blackshark V3 X Hyperspeed耳机推出了两款新配色，设计主题是宝可梦中相当酷的喷火龙和路卡利欧。这款耳机定位稍高，专为电竞调校，标准版比Kraken V4贵20美元(约合人民币134元)。它也更轻，重量为270克，而Kraken为300克。雷蛇宣称，这款耳机通过2.4GHz HyperSpeed技术提供低延迟无线连接，续航最长可达70小时。

paragraphs.en: The Charizard edition is colored in black and red flames with orange lining, while the Lucario model features vibrant blue earcubs and ink-like illustrations.
paragraphs.cn: 喷火龙版采用黑色与红色火焰配色，搭配橙色内衬；路卡利欧版则采用鲜亮的蓝色耳罩，并饰有水墨风格的插画。

paragraphs.en: Razer has previously released a number of Pokémon-themed peripherals, including a general Pokémon line of accessories and the viral Gengar headset . It’s not surprising to see the two companies lock hands once again for the gaming giant’s 30th anniversary.
paragraphs.cn: 雷蛇此前已经推出过多款《宝可梦》主题外设，包括《宝可梦》系列配件，以及曾在网上走红的耿鬼耳机。如今正值这个游戏巨头迎来30周年，两家公司再次联手并不令人意外。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile Target, which is selling the new Razer headsets at a significant markup, released an entire Pokémon anniversary collection earlier this summer.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，以明显更高的价格销售这些雷蛇新耳机的Target，已在今年夏季早些时候推出了一整套《宝可梦》周年纪念系列产品。
